title: The Linux pull-agent answer's firewall line puts add table before flush table and names the named-set caveat
goal: The _answers.md pull-agent line that says nft -f swaps a whole ruleset names add table before flush table and that named sets need flush set or destroy set, as line 2769 and QK-flush-idempotent-nft-f-file-need already say, so flush table no longer reads as sufficient and a first run on a missing table does not fail. Found by the SP-6ukmjucf review (S3).

run: import sys; ls=[l for l in open('kb/public/_answers.md',encoding='utf-8') if 'swaps a whole ruleset' in l]; sys.exit(0 if ls and all(all(n in l for n in ['add table', 'set']) for l in ls) else 1)

repro_reason: a content bug: the defect is the wording of a kb line, which only its text shows
